prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1446; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed rear-end collision in a parking lot, reporting neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with whiplash-type cervical strain. The mechanism of injury described is plausible for a collision of this nature. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical region. The patient's history includes a minor strain in the same area many years ago, which resolved completely without lasting limitation. Over the course of fifteen visits, care included manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program. Treatment followed a typical progression, with frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. At the most recent visit, the patient reported minimal residual discomfort and full return to daily activities. Two similar billing entries recorded on the same day are currently under review for accuracy. Discharge from active care is anticipated with a home exercise program and as-needed follow-up.
